messages:
emma_support: Hey team, customer ACME reports Trace view shows request IDs but no spans for ~30% of requests between 11:00-11:30 UTC. They see a request id (req_01F8Z9...) in API logs but clicking it in Console yields an empty trace. Screenshot: https://redwood.mock/s/ACME/trace-gap.png :thinking:
ryan_oncall: ack, adding P0 label. Can you paste a sample request ID and approximate org/customer id? :eyes:
emma_support: sample IDs: req_01F8Z9A3, req_01F8Z9B7. Org: acme-corp (org_44). Customer says it affects both Chat and generate endpoints.
sam_engineer: are spans missing entirely or just not linked? any errors in trace-ingest?
emma_support: console shows the request header but no spans listed. They have the event in API audit logs: `2026-01-18T11:08:12Z INFO request id=req_01F8Z9A3 status=200 latency_ms=142` but trace view empty. No obvious 5xx in their logs.
ryan_oncall: tagging infra and traces teams. @sam_engineer can you check consumer lag on kafka-traces-prod around that timeframe? infra_bot: Noted. Creating incident INC-2026-187 trace-ingest-gap.
sam_engineer: checking now. quick grep of trace-ingest logs shows a consumer error around 11:05: `WARN: dropping trace batch: missing trace_id header` repeated ~1200x. Could be header rename during deploy.
trace-bot: Deploy 2026-01-18 10:58 UTC by @deploybot: rolled out service=api-proxy v=2.14.7 -> v=2.15.0. Changed header propagation to `x-rd-trace-id` (new) but trace-ingest still expecting `trace-id` (old).
leah_product: that mismatch would break linking only — spans may still exist in traces topic but not associated with request ids in Console. Does the customer see any traces at all via raw trace search?
sam_engineer: quick check: consumer metrics show ~60s window where trace-ingest processed messages but logged "missing trace_id header" and dropped mapping. I can replay topic from offset and confirm spans exist with header `x-rd-trace-id` on messages.
emma_support: customer just sent a repro: POST /v1/chat with header `x-rd-trace-id: req_01F8Z9A3` and we saw spans in raw storage but Console linkage failed. They forwarded raw event blob.
ryan_oncall: mitigation plan? can we adapt trace-ingest to accept both headers and backfill links? :wrench:
sam_engineer: short term: patch trace-ingest to accept `x-rd-trace-id` and `trace-id` concurrently, deploy to staging, then prod. Medium: run a short consumer job to scan dropped messages and create links where possible. Long: add schema validation test to deploy pipeline to catch header name changes.
leah_product: notify affected customers and include ETA. Also add note in Console "partial trace data available" to reduce confusion.
emma_support: ACME asks for ETA and whether any tokens/billing affected (they worry about missing metrics).
ryan_oncall: no billing impact. ETA for hotfix? sam?
sam_engineer: I can prepare a hotfix branch now. If tests pass, deploy to prod in ~45 minutes. I'll also start the replay job to run after the patch, might take 2-3 hours to backfill the 11:00-11:30 window for that topic partition.
infra_bot: Running preflight checks for canary deploy.
trace-bot: canary deploy initiated for trace-ingest hotfix v=2.15.1 by @sam_engineer.
emma_support: sending interim update to ACME: "We identified a header propagation mismatch introduced in a recent deploy. Engineers are rolling a hotfix and will backfill traces for the affected window. No billing impact."
ryan_oncall: nice. after deploy, please paste the consumer log snippet showing acceptance of both headers. We should also collect sample raw events for audit.
sam_engineer: will do. here's planned patch (snippet):
```
// accept legacy and new header
traceId = headers.get("x-rd-trace-id") || headers.get("trace-id");
if (!traceId) { log.warn("missing trace_id header"); drop(); }
```

sam_engineer: updating tests, running CI.
leah_product: keep me posted on customer comms, I'll draft a short status note.
emma_support: customer replied "thanks for quick response, will wait for update" :thumbsup:
ryan_oncall: monitoring. once backfill completes, we'll verify links in Console and close INC-2026-187. Good triage everyone. :tada:
